# Desserts

Desserts merges the Parfait and Cocoa themes into a single light and dark theme with unified, refined styles. Cocoa serves as its dark mode and Parfait as its light mode, and left-aligned text is removed by default for a cleaner layout.

![Desserts screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incantatem2/Obsidian-desserts/HEAD/images/desserts-light-thumbnail.jpg)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Desserts"
    author: "incantatem2"
    repo:   "incantatem2/Obsidian-desserts"
    slug:   "desserts"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/desserts"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/incantatem2/Obsidian-desserts"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incantatem2/Obsidian-desserts/HEAD/images/desserts-light-thumbnail.jpg"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Merge Parfait and Cocoa into a single light/dark theme with unified, refined styles. Offer a dark Cocoa mode and a light Parfait mode with consistent visuals and remove left-aligned text by default for a cleaner layout."
}
```
